title: The Pre-Election Market Crash Pain RETURNS: Iran, Fed, Uncertainty, AI.
speaker: Meet Kevin (Kevin Paffrath)

macro_themes.view: Puts ~95% odds on a deal now, falling to ~70% after Oct 29 and ~30% after the Nov 3 election, after which he turns bearish ('bear mode for the winter').
Says 5.27% was near the top for the 10-year and yields are about to break below 5%, which helps TLT.
Brent at a five-month high ~$111 feeds inflation fears and market selling; no explicit oil forecast.
Market is worried about AI bubble and equity/debt raises (Meta CDS rising); he expects profitability only ~2028.
Gold struggles to rise without the money printer; needs Kevin Warsh to exit the Fed for gold to move.
Expects SpaceX to issue shares and buy Tesla at ~30% premium in 2027-mid 2028, before possible 2029 Democratic antitrust.

calls.condition: Buy the dip at 707-700; if no Iran deal by the election, expects bearish 'bear mode for the winter'.
calls.reason: Clean rejection at 715 on QQQ as predicted; 707-700 is the buy-the-dip zone ahead of an expected Iran deal, but odds fade after the election.
calls.quote: I like the idea of buying the dip at my 707 line or even between like or the 700 line if you really want to be aggressive.

calls.reason: Called 5.27% as near the top in September; yields falling (down 13.5bp today) despite Iran tension.
calls.quote: We made a call that 5.27 was pretty dang near the top... the 10-year Treasury is about to break below 5%.

calls.reason: TLT bottomed on a strong weekly line ~78.77 and rises as yields come down.
calls.quote: TLT we've been talking about as bottoming out on a very strong weekly line of 7877.

calls.condition: Gold needs Warsh to exit the Fed to start rising.
calls.reason: Without the money printer gold can't rally even in a risk-off war backdrop; gets sold to fund other buys like TLT.
calls.quote: when you take the money printer away, it's really hard for gold to go up.

calls.reason: Called a rejection at 165-166 on profit-taking back to 150 (hit); long-term bearish because SpaceX would issue dilutive shares to buy Tesla at a premium on a premium.
calls.quote: We said that's going to be a takerit and it'll go right back down to 150. And folks, here it is right at the 150 level.

calls.condition: Buy on dips to ~347 (or ~295 if no Iran deal); above 414 once an Iran deal comes. Risk: no deal/recession sinks it.
calls.reason: Expects SpaceX to acquire Tesla at ~30% premium in 2027-mid 2028; Tesla is overpriced but merger gives a floor, so buy volatility.
calls.quote: I think a 347 uh bounce point is a very good place to enter Tesla... when an Iran deal comes, we're going to end up being over 414 on Tesla.

notes: Date from CNBC clip 'Good Thursday morning' (Thursday 2026-10-22) and Trump's remarks 'on Wednesday'; listing said 2026-10-23. SpaceX ticker unclear (shares trade, quoted ~150-165); recorded as 'SPACEX'. LEN discussed (up ~7%, near book, 85.74 rejection line) but no bias given; skipped. Brent $111 noted without forecast. Gold bearish view is implied, low conviction.
